coverage.evidence: High-value command grammar, selectors, state access and topology effects are covered; the full Bedrock command surface is not.
mcstructure NBT, palette/index normalization and layer-length invariants are covered; full block/entity semantics are not.
Imports, module usage, events and dynamic-property calls are statically extracted without code execution.
Database presence and transport boundaries exist; most record families remain opaque.
No complete entity behavior/event lifecycle analyzer exists yet.
No generic automated entity runtime harness is integrated yet.
Broad scoreboard/tag writes are detected as cross-scope risk; session intent is not fully inferred.
State-machine/concurrency sequence generation is not implemented yet.
Automated multi-client runtime scenarios are not integrated yet.
Chunk lifecycle chaos/runtime coverage is not integrated yet.
Old-versus-new Minecraft runtime differential execution is not integrated yet.
